title: RFID Proximity Fobs
description: Proximity key fobs for access control and attendance systems, available in LF, HF and UHF formats with multiple shell styles and customization options.
summary: Proximity fobs are compact access credentials for doors, attendance terminals and lockers, available in multiple shell formats and LF, HF or UHF technology combinations.
Wide Selection: ProudTek has been supplying proximity fobs to worldwide since 2008, we have accumulated various molds.
Fine mold: ProudTek cooperate with the top mold partner, guarantee exquisite appearance and reasonable structure, and also customize according to clients’ special requirement.

faq.question: What are RFID Proximity Fobs commonly used for?
faq.answer: Best for simple access control, attendance, locker, and gate-entry systems that need compact proximity credentials in keychain form.

faq.question: Which chip, protocol, or frequency options are available for RFID Proximity Fobs?
faq.answer: 125 kHz Chip Options: EM4200, EM4305, T5577, 13.56 MHz Chip Options: MIFARE Classic 4K S50, 4K S70, MIFARE DESFire, Legic MIM256, 915 MHz Chip Options: H9, M4QT

faq.question: What material or form-factor options are available for RFID Proximity Fobs?
faq.answer: Material: ProudTek make RFID fobs with material of ABS, PC, PVC, epoxy, leather, silicone, glassfiber, wood etc. Depending on customer demand.

faq.question: How can RFID Proximity Fobs be customized?
faq.answer: Personalization: most advanced laser machine, UV printing, high quality silkscreen printing, code painting.
